test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The Speaker of the Lok Sabha is elected by:

options.text: all the members of Lok Sabha
members of majority party in Lok Sabha

solution:
The correct answer is __**all the members of Lok Sabha.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The Speaker is chosen by** newly elected members of** Lok Sabha.
 
• There are **no specific requirements** for becoming a speaker.
 
• The Speaker must only be a **member of the House of Representatives**, according to the constitution.
 
• An understanding of the **country's Constitution and legislation, procedure, and conventions of Parliament **is a vital asset for the speaker.
 
• A member belonging to** the rulling party** is elected.
 
• The **Deputy speaker **presides over the** **Lok sabha when the Speaker is **absent** from the sitting of the House 
 
• **Shri G.V. Mavalankar** was the **first Speaker** of the Lok Sabha. 
 
• **Shri Om Birla** is the** current Speaker** of the Lok Sabha.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• After the **first General Elections**, which took place from **25 October 1951 to 21 February 1952**, the Lok Sabha (House of the People) was duly formed on **17 April 1952.**
 
• The **First Lok Sabha's first session** began on **May 13, 1952.**
 
• The Lok Sabha is made up of **people's representatives** who are elected directly on the basis of adult suffrage. It is for this reason that it is known as the **popular chamber.**
 
• The first **Deputy Speaker** of the Lok Sabha was **Shri M. Ananthasayanam Ayyangar**.
